title: Japanese Broad Bean Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired stir fry made with broad beans, tender and hearty vegetables, and a hint of moroccan spices.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add broad beans and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add zaalouk, soy sauce, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter. Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve immediately, over steamed rice or noodles if desired.
